notablePrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Cast Squee from your graveyard or from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Iraxxa triggers, creating two 2/2 Alien Warrior creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing Squee and the Alien Warriors, adding {1}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.
